verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly say you can bring in Actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Rillet. They describe automated syncs with a configurable nightly refresh, the ability to stop a sync, and re-importing past months after fixing them in your books. Ari is said to connect to the ledger and keep the model current, so no manual exports are needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the connectors work as claimed, and per-connector depth such as account mapping or NetSuite-specific setup details.
